## SCT normalization
```{r SCT normalization}

sce_list <- list()  # holds the 2 separate results

for (nm in samples) {
  message("Processing native Seurat object: ", nm)
  seu_obj <- seu_list[[nm]]

  active_assay <- DefaultAssay(seu_obj)
  message("  Found active assay: '", active_assay, "'")

  seu_obj <- seu_obj[, colSums(GetAssayData(seu_obj, assay = active_assay, slot = "counts")) > 0]
  seu_obj <- SCTransform(seu_obj, assay = active_assay, verbose = FALSE)

  sce_final <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seu_obj)

  sct_residual_matrix <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = nrow(sce_final),
    ncol = ncol(sce_final),
    dimnames = list(rownames(sce_final), colnames(sce_final))
  )
  computed_residuals <- seu_obj[["SCT"]]$scale.data
  matching_genes <- intersect(rownames(sct_residual_matrix), rownames(computed_residuals))
  sct_residual_matrix[matching_genes, ] <- computed_residuals[matching_genes, ]

  assays(sce_final)[["SCT_residuals"]] <- sct_residual_matrix

  hvg_genes <- VariableFeatures(seu_obj)
  rowData(sce_final)$hvg <- rownames(sce_final) %in% hvg_genes
  metadata(sce_final)$sct_hvgs <- VariableFeatures(seu_obj)

  sce_list[[nm]] <- sce_final   # keep them separate, indexed by name
  message("  Stored normalized container for: ", nm,
          " (", ncol(sce_final), " bins retained)")
}

```


## Spatial coordinate helpers
```{r Spatial coordinate helpers}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# get_coords(): the ONLY source of spatial coordinates in this document.
# Reads GetTissueCoordinates() from the image object, matches barcodes to the
# SCE (which has fewer columns after the zero-count filter above), rescales
# full-resolution pixel coordinates into the lowres raster frame, and negates
# y so that plots come out upright without scale_y_reverse().
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_coords <- function(seu, sce, image_name = NULL) {
  if (is.null(image_name)) image_name <- Images(seu)[1]
  img <- seu[[image_name]]

  co <- GetTissueCoordinates(img)

  # barcodes live either in a 'cell' column or in the rownames
  bc <- if ("cell" %in% colnames(co)) as.character(co$cell) else rownames(co)

  # column naming differs between VisiumV1 (imagerow/imagecol) and VisiumV2 (x/y)
  xcol <- if ("imagecol" %in% colnames(co)) "imagecol" else "x"
  ycol <- if ("imagerow" %in% colnames(co)) "imagerow" else "y"

  idx <- match(colnames(sce), bc)
  if (anyNA(idx)) {
    stop(sum(is.na(idx)), " SCE barcodes have no entry in the tissue coordinates. ",
         "Did the SCE and the Seurat object come from the same sample?")
  }

  px <- as.numeric(co[[xcol]])[idx]
  py <- as.numeric(co[[ycol]])[idx]

  # coordinates are usually full-res while GetImage() returns the lowres raster
  he <- GetImage(img, mode = "raster")
  f  <- 1
  if (max(px, na.rm = TRUE) > ncol(he) * 1.05 ||
      max(py, na.rm = TRUE) > nrow(he) * 1.05) {
    f <- ScaleFactors(img)$lowres
    message("  rescaling coordinates by lowres factor ", signif(f, 4))
  }

  data.frame(x = px * f, y = -py * f)   # minus: see coordinate note at top
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# crop_he(): trim the H&E to the tissue-detected region and return the raster
# together with its bounds in the SAME coordinate frame get_coords() uses,
# so an H&E panel and a score panel line up without any flip or transpose.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
crop_he <- function(seu, image_name = NULL, pad_frac = 0.02) {
  if (is.null(image_name)) image_name <- Images(seu)[1]
  img <- seu[[image_name]]

  he <- GetImage(img, mode = "raster")
  ih <- nrow(he); iw <- ncol(he)

  co   <- GetTissueCoordinates(img)
  xcol <- if ("imagecol" %in% colnames(co)) "imagecol" else "x"
  ycol <- if ("imagerow" %in% colnames(co)) "imagerow" else "y"

  cx <- as.numeric(co[[xcol]])
  cy <- as.numeric(co[[ycol]])

  if (max(cx, na.rm = TRUE) > iw * 1.05 || max(cy, na.rm = TRUE) > ih * 1.05) {
    f  <- ScaleFactors(img)$lowres
    cx <- cx * f; cy <- cy * f
  }

  padx <- pad_frac * diff(range(cx, na.rm = TRUE))
  pady <- pad_frac * diff(range(cy, na.rm = TRUE))

  c1 <- max(1,  floor(min(cx, na.rm = TRUE) - padx))
  c2 <- min(iw, ceiling(max(cx, na.rm = TRUE) + padx))
  r1 <- max(1,  floor(min(cy, na.rm = TRUE) - pady))
  r2 <- min(ih, ceiling(max(cy, na.rm = TRUE) + pady))

  message("  full image ", iw, "x", ih,
          " -> crop ", c2 - c1 + 1, "x", r2 - r1 + 1)

  list(
    raster = he[r1:r2, c1:c2, drop = FALSE],
    xmin   =  c1, xmax =  c2,     # plot-space bounds, matching get_coords():
    ymin   = -r2, ymax = -r1      # y negated, so ymin is the more negative one
  )
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# he_panel(): an H&E panel in plot coordinates. No transpose, no flip -
# orientation is inherited from the coordinate frame, so this is correct for
# every sample regardless of how the section was laid on the slide.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
he_panel <- function(seu, label) {
  cr <- crop_he(seu)
  ggplot() +
    annotation_raster(cr$raster,
                      xmin = cr$xmin, xmax = cr$xmax,
                      ymin = cr$ymin, ymax = cr$ymax) +
    xlim(cr$xmin, cr$xmax) +
    ylim(cr$ymin, cr$ymax) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void() +
    labs(subtitle = paste0(label, " - H&E")) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10))
}


# --- build coordinates and H&E panels once, reused by every chunk below -----
coord_list <- list()
he_panels  <- list()

for (nm in samples) {
  message("Coordinates: ", nm)
  xy <- get_coords(seu_list[[nm]], sce_list[[nm]])
  coord_list[[nm]] <- data.frame(sample = nm, x = xy$x, y = xy$y)

  message("H&E: ", nm)
  he_panels[[nm]] <- he_panel(seu_list[[nm]], nm)
}

# sanity check: bin spacing in lowres pixels, useful for tuning point size
for (nm in samples) {
  d <- coord_list[[nm]]
  message(nm, ": x span ", signif(diff(range(d$x)), 4),
          " px, y span ", signif(diff(range(d$y)), 4),
          " px, n = ", nrow(d))
}

wrap_plots(he_panels, nrow = 1)

```



## Plotting of selected genes, both samples
```{r Plotting of selected genes}

genes_of_interest <- c("CCL19","CXCL13","CCL11","IL33","IL6",
                       "VCAM1","JCHAIN","CD4","CD3E","CD14",
                       "MCAM","CLU","IL7R","IL23R","PTPRC","CD19",
                       "IGHD","EOMES",
                       "PECAM1","CDH5","VWF",
                       "COL1A1","COL1A2","COL3A1","DCN","LUM","PDGFRA","PDGFRB",
                       "LYZ","CD14","CSF1R","CD68","S100A9","MRC1","SIGLEC1")
# NB: LY6G removed - no human ortholog. Use FCGR3B or CEACAM8 for neutrophils.

# --- prep each sample once, outside the gene loop ---
prep <- lapply(samples, function(nm) {
  sce_obj <- sce_list[[nm]]
  if (!"logcounts" %in% assayNames(sce_obj)) {
    stop("No logcounts in ", nm, " - was DefaultAssay 'SCT' at conversion?")
  }
  list(name = nm,
       expr = logcounts(sce_obj),
       x    = coord_list[[nm]]$x,
       y    = coord_list[[nm]]$y)
})
names(prep) <- samples

# genes present in the SCE but absent from the raw assay are real absences;
# genes absent here but present in RNA were dropped by SCTransform's min_cells
for (nm in samples) {
  gone <- setdiff(genes_of_interest, rownames(sce_list[[nm]]))
  if (length(gone))
    message(nm, " missing from SCT: ", paste(gone, collapse = ", "))
}

gene_plots <- list()

for (i in seq_along(genes_of_interest)) {
  gene <- genes_of_interest[i]

  # --- detectability per sample ---
  status <- lapply(prep, function(s) {
    in_object <- gene %in% rownames(s$expr)
    e <- if (in_object) as.numeric(s$expr[gene, ]) else NULL
    list(in_object  = in_object,
         expr       = e,
         detectable = in_object && any(e > 0))
  })

  det <- vapply(status, `[[`, logical(1), "detectable")

  message("Plotting ", i, "/", length(genes_of_interest), ": ", gene,
          "  [", paste(samples, ifelse(det, "ok", "not detectable"),
                       sep = ": ", collapse = "; "), "]")

  # --- shared colour limits across whichever samples have signal ---
  lims <- if (any(det)) {
    range(unlist(lapply(status[det], `[[`, "expr")), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else NULL

  panels <- lapply(samples, function(nm) {
    s  <- prep[[nm]]
    st <- status[[nm]]

    if (st$detectable) {
      df <- data.frame(x = s$x, y = s$y, expression = st$expr)
      df <- df[order(df$expression), ]          # positive spots drawn on top

      ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = expression)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
        scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", limits = lims) +
        coord_fixed() + theme_void() +
        labs(subtitle = nm, color = "LogExpr") +
        theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10))
    } else {
      df     <- data.frame(x = s$x, y = s$y)
      reason <- if (!st$in_object) "not in dataset" else "all zero"

      ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4, color = "grey80") +
        coord_fixed() + theme_void() +
        labs(subtitle = paste0(nm, " - not detectable")) +
        annotate("text",
                 x = mean(range(s$x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 y = mean(range(s$y, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 label = paste0("Not detectable\n(", reason, ")"),
                 fontface = "italic", size = 4, color = "grey30") +
        theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10))
    }
  })
  names(panels) <- samples

  # scores on the top row, matching H&E below
  p <- wrap_plots(c(panels, he_panels), ncol = length(samples)) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title = gene,
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
    )

  gene_plots[[gene]] <- p
  print(p)
}

```


## Set up cell type signatures
```{r Set up cell types}

my_signatures <- list(
  VEC     = c("PECAM1","CLDN5", "ACKR1","VWF","PLVAP","ICAM2","AQP1"),
  PeriFb_VSMC = c("COL1A1","COL1A2","MYL9","LUM","ACTA2","PDGFRB","TAGLN","MYH11"),
  FRC     = c("CCL19","PDPN","VCAM1","IL33","CLU","IL7","CXCL12","DCN"),   
  Myeloid = c("LYZ", "S100A9", "S100A8", "CTSS", "CST3", "GPNMB","CD68","MRC1"),
  Tcell   = c("CD3D","CD3E","CD3G","IL7R","TRBC1", "TRBC2", "TRAC"),
  Bcell   = c("MS4A1","CD79A","CD79B","IGHM","MZB1", "XBP1", "CD38")
)

# genes must be present in EVERY object so scores use the same gene set
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(sce_list[samples], rownames))
sig_present  <- lapply(my_signatures, intersect, common_genes)

for (s in names(my_signatures)) {
  missing <- setdiff(my_signatures[[s]], sig_present[[s]])
  message(s, ": ", length(sig_present[[s]]), "/", length(my_signatures[[s]]), " present",
          if (length(missing)) paste0("  MISSING: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", ")) else "")
}

sig_use <- sig_present[lengths(sig_present) >= 3]
message("Using ", length(sig_use), " signatures: ", paste(names(sig_use), collapse = ", "))

cell_colors <- c(
  VEC        = "#ff7f0e",
  PeriFb_VSMC         = "#2ca02c",
  FRC        = "#E41A1C",
  Myeloid    = "#e377c2",
  Tcell      = "#bcbd22",
  Bcell      = "#17becf",
  Unassigned = "grey90"
)
```

## Cell type projection
```{r Cell type projection}

score_signature <- function(sce, genes) {
  mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(sce, "logcounts")[genes, , drop = FALSE]
  mat <- as.matrix(base::as.matrix(mat))     # force a real base matrix
  storage.mode(mat) <- "double"
  mu  <- base::rowMeans(mat)
  sdv <- sqrt(base::rowSums((mat - mu)^2) / (ncol(mat) - 1))
  sdv[sdv == 0 | is.na(sdv)] <- 1            # zero-variance genes -> score 0
  z <- (mat - mu) / sdv
  base::colMeans(z)
}

score_list <- list()

for (nm in samples) {
  sce_obj <- sce_list[[nm]]
  message("Scoring: ", nm)

  m <- sapply(sig_use, function(g) score_signature(sce_obj, g))
  stopifnot(is.matrix(m), nrow(m) == ncol(sce_obj),
            nrow(m) == nrow(coord_list[[nm]]))

  score_list[[nm]] <- m
  message("  ", nrow(m), " bins x ", ncol(m), " signatures")
}

# keep signatures with non-zero variance in ALL samples
keep <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(score_list, function(m) colnames(m)[apply(m, 2, sd) > 0]))
score_list <- lapply(score_list, function(m) m[, keep, drop = FALSE])
message("Retained: ", paste(keep, collapse = ", "))

```

```{r}


score_ucell <- function(sce, sigs, maxRank = 1500, ncores = 4) {
  cnt <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(sce, "counts")
  if (is.null(colnames(cnt)) || anyDuplicated(colnames(cnt)))
    stop("Bins need unique colnames to keep scores aligned with coordinates")

  # drop genes absent from the matrix and report them
  sigs <- lapply(sigs, function(g) {
    miss <- setdiff(g, rownames(cnt))
    if (length(miss)) message("  missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
    intersect(g, rownames(cnt))
  })
  sigs <- sigs[lengths(sigs) > 0]

  sc <- ScoreSignatures_UCell(
    matrix     = cnt,
    features   = sigs,
    maxRank    = maxRank,
    name       = "",          # keep signature names without "_UCell" suffix
    chunk.size = 2000,
    BPPARAM    = MulticoreParam(ncores)   # use SnowParam() or SerialParam() on Windows
  )

  sc[colnames(sce), names(sigs), drop = FALSE]   # enforce bin order
}

# choose maxRank from the data: roughly the number of genes detected per bin
detected <- unlist(lapply(sce_list, function(s)
  Matrix::colSums(SummarizedExperiment::assay(s, "counts") > 0)))
print(summary(detected))
max_rank <- max(100, ceiling(quantile(detected, 0.9)))

score_list <- list()

for (nm in samples) {
  sce_obj <- sce_list[[nm]]
  message("Scoring (UCell): ", nm)

  m <- score_ucell(sce_obj, sig_use, maxRank = max_rank)
  stopifnot(nrow(m) == ncol(sce_obj),
            nrow(m) == nrow(coord_list[[nm]]))

  score_list[[nm]] <- m
  message("  ", nrow(m), " bins x ", ncol(m), " signatures")
}

# keep signatures with non-zero variance in ALL samples
keep <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(score_list, function(m) colnames(m)[apply(m, 2, sd) > 0]))
score_list <- lapply(score_list, function(m) m[, keep, drop = FALSE])
message("Retained: ", paste(keep, collapse = ", "))



```

## Signature score maps, per-type colour
```{r Signature score maps per-type colour}
cts <- intersect(keep, names(cell_colors))
missing_col <- setdiff(keep, names(cell_colors))
if (length(missing_col))
  message("No colour defined, skipping: ", paste(missing_col, collapse = ", "))
stopifnot(length(cts) > 0)

score_plots <- list()

for (i in seq_along(cts)) {
  ct <- cts[i]
  message("Plotting ", i, "/", length(cts), ": ", ct)

  # UCell scores start at 0: grey = no signal, cell-type colour = high enrichment
  lims <- c(0, quantile(unlist(lapply(score_list, function(m) m[, ct])),
                        0.99, na.rm = TRUE))

  panels <- lapply(samples, function(nm) {
    d <- data.frame(x     = coord_list[[nm]]$x,
                    y     = coord_list[[nm]]$y,
                    score = score_list[[nm]][, ct])
    d <- d[order(d$score), ]

    ggplot(d, aes(x = x, y = y, color = score)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "grey92", high = cell_colors[[ct]],
                           limits = lims, oob = scales::squish) +
      coord_fixed() + theme_void() +
      labs(subtitle = nm, color = "UCell score") +
      theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10))
  })
  names(panels) <- samples

  p <- wrap_plots(c(panels, he_panels), ncol = length(samples)) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title = ct,
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13))
    )

  score_plots[[ct]] <- p
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
# ---- Settings ----
min_score  <- 0    # top score must exceed this, otherwise "Unassigned"
min_margin <- 0       # e.g. 0.02 = top score must beat the runner-up by this much
scale_sigs <- FALSE   # TRUE = rescale each signature before comparing (see note)

# optional: rescale each signature by its pooled 99th percentile across samples
sig_ref <- sapply(cts, function(ct)
  quantile(unlist(lapply(score_list, function(m) m[, ct])), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
sig_ref[sig_ref == 0] <- 1

assign_winner <- function(m) {
  m <- m[, cts, drop = FALSE]
  if (scale_sigs) m <- sweep(m, 2, sig_ref[cts], "/")

  idx    <- max.col(m, ties.method = "first")
  top    <- m[cbind(seq_len(nrow(m)), idx)]
  m2     <- m
  m2[cbind(seq_len(nrow(m)), idx)] <- -Inf
  second <- do.call(pmax, as.data.frame(m2))

  label <- colnames(m)[idx]
  label[top <= min_score | (top - second) < min_margin] <- "Unassigned"

  data.frame(celltype = factor(label, levels = c(cts, "Unassigned")),
             top_score = top,
             margin    = top - second)
}

winner_list <- lapply(score_list, assign_winner)

})
```

```{r Cell type distribution}
# ---- Build assign_df from the winner-takes-all result ----
assign_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(samples, function(nm) {
  data.frame(sample = nm,
             x      = coord_list[[nm]]$x,
             y      = coord_list[[nm]]$y,
             label  = winner_list[[nm]]$celltype)
}))
assign_df$label <- factor(assign_df$label, levels = c(cts, "Unassigned"))

# Extract all valid cell types to loop through (ignoring "Unassigned")
cell_types <- levels(assign_df$label)
cell_types <- cell_types[cell_types != "Unassigned"]

highlight_plots <- list()

# Loop through each cell type
for (ctype in cell_types) {

  # 1. Everything grey (including Unassigned), target cell type in its own colour
  highlight_colors <- setNames(rep("grey85", length(levels(assign_df$label))),
                               levels(assign_df$label))
  highlight_colors[ctype] <- cell_colors[[ctype]]

  # 2. Draw the target cell type last (on top)
  plot_df_loop <- assign_df
  plot_df_loop$is_target <- plot_df_loop$label == ctype
  plot_df_loop <- plot_df_loop[order(plot_df_loop$is_target), ]

  # 3. One panel per sample
  tile_panels_loop <- lapply(samples, function(nm) {
    d <- plot_df_loop[plot_df_loop$sample == nm, ]
    n_target <- sum(d$is_target)
    pct      <- round(100 * n_target / nrow(d), 1)

    ggplot(d, aes(x = x, y = y, color = label)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.15) +
      scale_color_manual(values = highlight_colors, drop = FALSE) +
      coord_fixed() +
      theme_void() +
      labs(subtitle = sprintf("%s\n%s bins (%s%%)", nm,
                              format(n_target, big.mark = ","), pct)) +
      theme(
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none"
      )
  })

  # 4. Assemble panels
  celltype_map_single <- wrap_plots(tile_panels_loop, nrow = 1) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = sprintf("Spatial Distribution: %s (one cell type per spot)", ctype),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
    )

  highlight_plots[[ctype]] <- celltype_map_single

  # 5. Print
  print(celltype_map_single)
}
```

```{r}
diag_orient <- function(swap, flip_x, flip_y) {
  s  <- sfs$lowres
  pr <- (if (swap) coords$x else coords$y) * s
  pc <- (if (swap) coords$y else coords$x) * s
  if (flip_y) pr <- dim(img)[1] - pr
  if (flip_x) pc <- dim(img)[2] - pc

  d <- data.frame(px = pc, py = pr)
  d <- d[sample(nrow(d), min(20000, nrow(d))), ]

  ggplot(d, aes(px, -py)) +
    annotation_raster(img, xmin = 0, xmax = dim(img)[2],
                      ymin = -dim(img)[1], ymax = 0) +
    geom_point(size = 0.1, color = "red", alpha = 0.3) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, dim(img)[2]), ylim = c(-dim(img)[1], 0), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(subtitle = sprintf("swap=%s | flip_x=%s | flip_y=%s", swap, flip_x, flip_y)) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8))
}

grid <- expand.grid(swap = c(TRUE, FALSE), flip_x = c(FALSE, TRUE), flip_y = c(FALSE, TRUE))
wrap_plots(lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i)
  diag_orient(grid$swap[i], grid$flip_x[i], grid$flip_y[i])), ncol = 4)
```

```{r}

# ---- Settings ----
# =====================================================================
nm          <- "obj2"
seu_obj     <- obj2                   # the Seurat object for this sample
swap_xy     <- FALSE                  # confirmed by orientation diagnostic
flip_x      <- FALSE
flip_y      <- FALSE

xlim_z      <- c(100, 265)            # zoom window in coord_list units
ylim_z      <- c(-405, -295)

markers     <- c("CCL19", "CD3E", "PECAM1")
marker_cols <- c(CCL19 = "#00BFFF", CD3E = "#FFD700", PECAM1 = "#FF1493")   # cyan, yellow, deep pink
pt_full     <- 0.15                   # point size on the captured-area view
pt_zoom     <- 1                      # point size on the zoomed view
alpha_range <- c(0.3, 1)              # low -> high expression
margin      <- 0.02                   # padding around the captured area (fraction of its size)

# =====================================================================
# ---- Image, scale factor and pixel coordinates (Seurat) ----
# =====================================================================
img_name <- Images(seu_obj)[1]
img      <- seu_obj[[img_name]]@image
scale    <- ScaleFactors(seu_obj[[img_name]])$lowres
coords   <- GetTissueCoordinates(seu_obj, image = img_name)

pix_row <- if (swap_xy) coords$x else coords$y
pix_col <- if (swap_xy) coords$y else coords$x
if (flip_y) pix_row <- dim(img)[1] / scale - pix_row
if (flip_x) pix_col <- dim(img)[2] / scale - pix_col

# =====================================================================
# ---- Expression per bin from logcounts (SCE) ----
# =====================================================================
sce_obj <- sce_list[[nm]]
if (!"logcounts" %in% assayNames(sce_obj))
  stop("No logcounts in ", nm)

gone <- setdiff(markers, rownames(sce_obj))
if (length(gone)) message(nm, " missing from SCT: ", paste(gone, collapse = ", "))
markers <- intersect(markers, rownames(sce_obj))

lc <- as.matrix(logcounts(sce_obj)[markers, , drop = FALSE])

det <- rowSums(lc > 0) > 0
if (any(!det)) message("Not detectable (all zero): ", paste(markers[!det], collapse = ", "))
markers <- markers[det]
stopifnot(length(markers) > 0)

# ---- Match SCE bins to Seurat pixel coordinates ----
m <- match(colnames(sce_obj), coords$cell)
if (mean(!is.na(m)) < 0.99) {
  message("nm = ", nm, " | matched: ", round(100 * mean(!is.na(m)), 1), "%")
  message("SCE barcodes:    ", paste(head(colnames(sce_obj), 3), collapse = ", "))
  message("Seurat barcodes: ", paste(head(coords$cell, 3), collapse = ", "))
  stop("Barcodes of sce_list[[nm]] and the Seurat object do not match")
}

df <- data.frame(cell = colnames(sce_obj),
                 px   = pix_col[m],
                 py   = pix_row[m],
                 gx   = coord_list[[nm]]$x,      # grid coordinates, used for the zoom window
                 gy   = coord_list[[nm]]$y)
df <- cbind(df, t(lc[markers, , drop = FALSE]))

# cap each marker at its 99th percentile of positive bins
q99 <- setNames(
  sapply(markers, function(g) unname(quantile(df[[g]][df[[g]] > 0], 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))),
  markers
)
print(q99)

# =====================================================================
# ---- Crops: captured area and zoom window ----
# =====================================================================
crop_he <- function(xlim, ylim) {
  r1 <- max(1, floor(ylim[1] * scale));  r2 <- min(dim(img)[1], ceiling(ylim[2] * scale))
  c1 <- max(1, floor(xlim[1] * scale));  c2 <- min(dim(img)[2], ceiling(xlim[2] * scale))
  if (r1 >= r2 || c1 >= c2)
    stop(sprintf("Crop outside image: rows %d-%d, cols %d-%d, image %d x %d",
                 r1, r2, c1, c2, dim(img)[1], dim(img)[2]))
  annotation_raster(img[r1:r2, c1:c2, , drop = FALSE],
                    xmin = (c1 - 1) / scale, xmax = c2 / scale,
                    ymin = -r2 / scale,      ymax = -(r1 - 1) / scale)
}

# captured area = extent of all bins + margin
bx <- range(df$px, na.rm = TRUE)
by <- range(df$py, na.rm = TRUE)
full_xlim <- c(max(0, bx[1] - diff(bx) * margin), min(dim(img)[2] / scale, bx[2] + diff(bx) * margin))
full_ylim <- c(max(0, by[1] - diff(by) * margin), min(dim(img)[1] / scale, by[2] + diff(by) * margin))

# zoom window: select bins by grid coordinates, then take their pixel extent
in_zoom <- df$gx >= xlim_z[1] & df$gx <= xlim_z[2] &
           df$gy >= ylim_z[1] & df$gy <= ylim_z[2]
stopifnot(sum(in_zoom) > 0)
px_lim <- range(df$px[in_zoom], na.rm = TRUE)
py_lim <- range(df$py[in_zoom], na.rm = TRUE)

panel_theme <- theme_void() +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.border  = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5))

views <- list(
  Full = list(
    he    = crop_he(full_xlim, full_ylim),
    coord = coord_fixed(xlim = full_xlim, ylim = -rev(full_ylim), expand = FALSE),
    frame = data.frame(x = full_xlim, y = -full_ylim),
    xlim  = full_xlim, ylim = full_ylim,
    pt    = pt_full,
    box   = TRUE
  ),
  Zoom = list(
    he    = crop_he(px_lim, py_lim),
    coord = coord_fixed(xlim = px_lim, ylim = -rev(py_lim), expand = FALSE),
    frame = data.frame(x = px_lim, y = -py_lim),
    xlim  = px_lim, ylim = py_lim,
    pt    = pt_zoom,
    box   = FALSE
  )
)

# =====================================================================
# ---- Panel builder: loops over markers; legend only on merged panel ----
# =====================================================================
make_marker_panel <- function(genes, view, title) {
  p <- ggplot(view$frame, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_blank() +
    view$he

  for (i in seq_along(genes)) {
    g <- genes[i]
    d <- df[df[[g]] > 0 &
            df$px >= view$xlim[1] & df$px <= view$xlim[2] &
            df$py >= view$ylim[1] & df$py <= view$ylim[2], ]
    d$gene <- g
    d$a    <- pmin(d[[g]] / q99[[g]], 1)

    p <- p + geom_point(data = d, aes(px, -py, color = gene, alpha = a),
                        shape = 15, size = view$pt, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }

  if (view$box)
    p <- p + annotate("rect", xmin = px_lim[1], xmax = px_lim[2],
                      ymin = -py_lim[2], ymax = -py_lim[1],
                      fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6)

  leg <- if (length(genes) == length(markers))
    guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)) else "none"

  p +
    scale_color_manual(values = marker_cols[markers], limits = markers,
                       name = "Marker", guide = leg) +
    scale_alpha_continuous(range = alpha_range, limits = c(0, 1), guide = "none") +
    view$coord + panel_theme +
    labs(subtitle = title)
}

# =====================================================================
# ---- Build panels: loop over views, then over markers ----
# =====================================================================
marker_panels <- list()

for (v in names(views)) {
  view <- views[[v]]

  marker_panels[[paste(v, "HE")]] <- make_marker_panel(character(0), view, paste(v, "- H&E"))

  for (i in seq_along(markers)) {
    g <- markers[i]
    marker_panels[[paste(v, g)]] <- make_marker_panel(g, view, paste(v, "-", g))
  }

  marker_panels[[paste(v, "merged")]] <- make_marker_panel(markers, view,
                                          paste(v, "-", paste(markers, collapse = " + ")))
}

# =====================================================================
# ---- Assemble: row 1 = captured area, row 2 = zoom ----
# =====================================================================
p_markers <- wrap_plots(marker_panels, ncol = length(markers) + 2) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = sprintf("%s: %s on H&E", nm, paste(markers, collapse = ", ")),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10))
  )

print(p_markers)

# ggsave(sprintf("markers_%s.pdf", nm), p_markers, width = 20, height = 8)
```

```{r}
other_col   <- "grey80"   # colour for bins not of the projected cell type
other_alpha <- 0.6        # lower = more H&E visible under the grey bins

plot_he_overlay <- function(types, title) {
  d <- dz
  d$fill_lab <- ifelse(d$label %in% types, as.character(d$label), "Other")
  d$fill_lab <- factor(d$fill_lab, levels = c("Other", show_types))
  d_other  <- d[d$fill_lab == "Other", ]
  d_target <- d[d$fill_lab != "Other", ]

  ggplot(d, aes(px, -py)) +
    geom_blank() +
    he_layer +
    geom_tile(data = d_other, fill = other_col,
              width = bin_px, height = bin_px, alpha = other_alpha) +
    geom_tile(data = d_target, aes(fill = fill_lab),
              width = bin_px, height = bin_px, alpha = alpha_ov) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = unlist(cell_colors[show_types]), breaks = show_types,
                      limits = show_types, name = "Cell type") +
    zoom_coord + panel_theme +
    labs(subtitle = title)
}

# ---- One panel per cell type (with bin count) + merged ----
type_panels <- lapply(show_types, function(ct) {
  n <- sum(dz$label == ct)
  plot_he_overlay(ct, sprintf("%s\n(n = %s)", ct, format(n, big.mark = ",")))
})

p_he_merge <- plot_he_overlay(show_types, "All cell types")

# ---- Assemble ----
p_zoom_he <- wrap_plots(c(list(p_he), type_panels, list(p_he_merge)), ncol = ncol_grid) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = sprintf("%s: all cell types on H&E (zoom)", nm),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10))
  )

print(p_zoom_he)


```



```{r}


show_types2 <- setdiff(levels(assign_df$label), "Unassigned")   # all cell types
stopifnot(all(show_types2 %in% names(cell_colors)))

# =====================================================================
# ---- Zoom 2: smaller window for nuclear detail (separate names) ----
# =====================================================================
xlim_z2      <- c(145, 205)     # in coord_list units
ylim_z2      <- c(-400, -340)
alpha_ov2    <- 0.5             # lower than zoom 1 so nuclei stay visible under the tiles
other_col2   <- "grey80"
other_alpha2 <- 0.3
crop_px2     <- "2500"          # output width of the H&E crop in pixels

# ---- Bins inside zoom 2 ----
dz2 <- d_all[d_all$x >= xlim_z2[1] & d_all$x <= xlim_z2[2] &
             d_all$y >= ylim_z2[1] & d_all$y <= ylim_z2[2], ]
stopifnot(nrow(dz2) > 0)
px_lim2 <- range(dz2$px) + c(-bin_px, bin_px) / 2   # include the full edge bins
py_lim2 <- range(dz2$py) + c(-bin_px, bin_px) / 2

zoom_coord2 <- coord_fixed(xlim = px_lim2, ylim = -rev(py_lim2), expand = FALSE)

# ---- Hi-res H&E crop (full-res JPG, same pixel space as coords) ----
geom2 <- sprintf("%dx%d+%d+%d",
                 ceiling(diff(px_lim2)), ceiling(diff(py_lim2)),
                 floor(px_lim2[1]), floor(py_lim2[1]))
he_crop2  <- as.raster(image_scale(image_crop(full, geom2), crop_px2))
he_layer2 <- annotation_raster(he_crop2, xmin = px_lim2[1], xmax = px_lim2[2],
                               ymin = -py_lim2[2], ymax = -py_lim2[1])
message("Zoom 2: ", nrow(dz2), " bins, crop ", geom2, " full-res px")

# ---- H&E panel ----
p_he2 <- ggplot(dz2, aes(px, -py)) +
  geom_blank() +
  he_layer2 +
  zoom_coord2 +
  panel_theme +
  labs(subtitle = "H&E")

# ---- Overlay function for zoom 2 ----
plot_he_overlay2 <- function(types, title) {
  d <- dz2
  d$fill_lab <- ifelse(d$label %in% types, as.character(d$label), "Other")
  d$fill_lab <- factor(d$fill_lab, levels = c("Other", show_types))
  d_other  <- d[d$fill_lab == "Other", ]
  d_target <- d[d$fill_lab != "Other", ]

  ggplot(d, aes(px, -py)) +
    geom_blank() +
    he_layer2 +
    geom_tile(data = d_other, fill = other_col2,
              width = bin_px, height = bin_px, alpha = other_alpha2) +
    geom_tile(data = d_target, aes(fill = fill_lab),
              width = bin_px, height = bin_px, alpha = alpha_ov2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = unlist(cell_colors[show_types]), breaks = show_types,
                      limits = show_types, name = "Cell type") +
    zoom_coord2 + panel_theme +
    labs(subtitle = title)
}

# ---- One panel per cell type + merged ----
type_panels2 <- lapply(show_types, function(ct) {
  n <- sum(dz2$label == ct)
  plot_he_overlay2(ct, sprintf("%s\n(n = %s)", ct, format(n, big.mark = ",")))
})

p_he_merge2 <- plot_he_overlay2(show_types, "All cell types")

# ---- Assemble ----
p_zoom_he2 <- wrap_plots(c(list(p_he2), type_panels2, list(p_he_merge2)), ncol = ncol_grid) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = sprintf("%s: all cell types on H&E (zoom 2)", nm),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10))
  )

print(p_zoom_he2)
```

##QC check of unassigned spots
```{r}
library(Matrix)

chk_nm <- "obj2"                       # separate name so nm is not touched
sce_chk <- sce_list[[chk_nm]]
cnt     <- counts(sce_chk)
w       <- winner_list[[chk_nm]]
un      <- w$celltype == "Unassigned"
cat("Unassigned:", sum(un), "| assigned:", sum(!un), "\n")

# ---- 1. QC: are Unassigned bins just low-quality / low-count? ----
qc <- data.frame(group  = ifelse(un, "Unassigned", "Assigned"),
                 umi    = colSums(cnt),
                 ngenes = colSums(cnt > 0))
print(aggregate(cbind(umi, ngenes) ~ group, data = qc, FUN = median))
cat("max_rank used in UCell:", max_rank, "\n")
cat("Unassigned bins detecting more genes than max_rank (%):",
    round(100 * mean(qc$ngenes[un] > max_rank), 1), "\n")

# ---- 2. Signature genes: detected in Unassigned bins? ----
sig_df <- stack(sig_use)                       # values = gene, ind = cell type
names(sig_df) <- c("gene", "celltype")
sig_df <- sig_df[sig_df$gene %in% rownames(cnt), ]

sig_df$pct_unassigned <- round(100 * rowMeans(cnt[sig_df$gene, un,  drop = FALSE] > 0), 2)
sig_df$pct_assigned   <- round(100 * rowMeans(cnt[sig_df$gene, !un, drop = FALSE] > 0), 2)
sig_df <- sig_df[order(-sig_df$pct_unassigned), ]
print(sig_df, row.names = FALSE)

cat("Unassigned bins with >= 1 signature UMI (%):",
    round(100 * mean(colSums(cnt[unique(sig_df$gene), un, drop = FALSE]) > 0), 1), "\n")

# ---- 3. What do Unassigned bins express? ----
pct_un   <- rowMeans(cnt[, un,  drop = FALSE] > 0)
pct_as   <- rowMeans(cnt[, !un, drop = FALSE] > 0)
mean_un  <- rowMeans(cnt[, un,  drop = FALSE])

gene_tab <- data.frame(gene           = rownames(cnt),
                       pct_unassigned = round(100 * pct_un, 2),
                       pct_assigned   = round(100 * pct_as, 2),
                       mean_count_un  = round(mean_un, 3),
                       log2_enrich    = round(log2((pct_un + 0.001) / (pct_as + 0.001)), 2),
                       in_signature   = rownames(cnt) %in% sig_df$gene,
                       mito_ribo      = grepl("^MT-|^RP[SL]", rownames(cnt)))

# 3a. most frequently detected genes in Unassigned bins
top_detected <- head(gene_tab[order(-gene_tab$pct_unassigned), ], 30)
print(top_detected, row.names = FALSE)

# 3b. genes enriched in Unassigned vs assigned bins (detected in >= 5% of Unassigned)
top_enriched <- gene_tab[gene_tab$pct_unassigned >= 5, ]
top_enriched <- head(top_enriched[order(-top_enriched$log2_enrich), ], 30)
print(top_enriched, row.names = FALSE)

# ---- Save full tables ----
write.csv(gene_tab[order(-gene_tab$pct_unassigned), ],
          sprintf("unassigned_genes_%s.csv", chk_nm), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sig_df, sprintf("unassigned_signature_genes_%s.csv", chk_nm), row.names = FALSE)
```
